sources.title: Deploying Gemma 4 26B A4B on an RTX 5090
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 26B A4B is an MoE model: 26B total params but only 4B active per token. That combination suits decode-heavy workloads on a single consumer GPU — you get the capability of a 26B model with the memory bandwidth cost of a 4B model during generation. Benchmarks put it competitive with 30B+ dense models on coding and reasoning tasks.

sources.snippet: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's new family of open models, including 12B, E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B, and 31B. The multimodal, hybrid-thinking models support 140+ languages, up to 256K context, and have dense and MoE variants.
